compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a fitness assessment, specifically the fourth and final step (4/4). The screen asks the user, "What makes it hard for you to be more active?" and allows the user to select up to two options from the following choices:

- Limited Time
- No Energy
- Motivation
- Need Guidance
- Nothing!

Below the options, there is a note stating, "Our at-home workouts are often less than 10 minutes and require no equipment!" At the bottom right corner, there is a "NEXT" button for the user to proceed to the next step.
